messages:
Casey (AE): Hey team — SableAI just confirmed a short POC. They want Redwood to serve three variants: `sable-small` (7B FP16), `sable-base-quant` (13B int8), and `sable-chat-2.1` (13B chat-tuned). Key asks from customer: KV cache support for chat, on-prem option (air-gapped), KMS for keys, and a pricing/throughput estimate for an initial 2-week pilot. Can we run a quick compatibility + perf checklist?

Alex (Solutions): Nice — quick checklist idea: 1) confirm HF/weights layout + tokenizer; 2) try our conversion script to quantize/verify operator coverage; 3) run a small perf job (1 GPU, sequence 512, batch 8) to capture memory and latency; 4) validate KV cache correctness with a chat replay. I can drive steps 2-4 if you drop the model links.

Casey (AE): Model repo links from SableAI in a thread below (they shared a tarball URL). Also they flagged HIPAA-ish data in POC so Jun, can you flag anything from a security angle early?

Jun (Security): HIPAA: doable but need KMS in-scope + audit logs + isolation. For private/on-prem: customer-managed HSM or integration to their KMS required. Also need to know if model weights contain any restricted license. Ask legal to confirm model license compatibility.

Ravi (SRE): For quantized 13B (int8) we need to verify kernel coverage. If conv->quant path ends up using unsupported ops we'll fallback to fp16 which increases mem by ~2x. Can we get the HF model_id or the raw checkpoint? Small checklist from infra side: - model file shapes (tensor names) - tokenizer type (byte-level/BPE) - sample input tokenization size distribution - target p95 latency SLO for POC

Marta (ML Eng): Quick note on `sable-chat-2.1`: it uses a context-manager style system prompt and incremental role tokens — we should validate that our prefix-caching preserves role boundaries. Also quantization can change logits slightly; we'll run a quality check (ROUGE/LLM eval on a 50 prompt set).

Casey (AE): Customer wants ~200 concurrent users, typical session = 80 tokens request + 150 tokens response, estimate 2k requests/day spiky to 300 rps during demo windows. They asked for a 2-week pilot cost ballpark (hosted vs dedicated vs private).

Alex (Solutions): Pricing quick-ballpark: for hosted (mixed fp16/int8) assume token cost + compute amortized. For dedicated: recommend reserved capacity with 2x A40/A100 equiv for safe headroom for the chat model under target concurrency. I'll give a more concrete compute estimate after the perf run, but expect dedicated monthly commit around $Xk for 2 GPUs; pilot pro-rate will be a fraction. (I'll follow up with numbers once we have memory/throughput).

Ravi (SRE): Proposed quick-run commands (upload model -> run scan):
```bash
# convert/check ops
python infra/tools/convert_model.py --input /tmp/sable --out /tmp/converted --quantize int8
# perf run
./infra/bin/perf_runner --model /tmp/converted --seq-len 512 --batch 8 --warmup 50 --iters 200
```
I'll kick this off once Alex confirms we have the right artifacts.

sre-deploy-bot: Scan request queued: job_id=jb-20260321-42, estimated runtime 12m. Link: https://ci.redwood/scan/jb-20260321-42

Marta (ML Eng): On evaluation: I'll prepare a 50-prompt set focusing on chat safety, hallucination, and instruction-following. For quant variants we'll compute delta against the fp16 baseline. Acceptable degradation = <2% on our scorecard.

Jun (Security): For HIPAA: also confirm that logs for the POC are retained only in RDW-controlled S3 with encryption enabled and access limited to the SE/Eng team. Customer will want an NDA addendum for data handling; Casey pls coordinate legal.

Casey (AE): I'll ping SableAI to provide: tarball link, model license, sample tokenization trace, and confirm NDA addendum. Can we aim to have the perf/compat report by EOD tomorrow?

Alex (Solutions): Yes — assuming artifacts arrive today I'll run conversion + perf tonight and post results here. If we hit an unsupported op in int8 path we'll document fallback options.

Ravi (SRE): If we need private/on-prem for HIPAA, timeline for an on-prem deploy is ~3-4 weeks (air-gap pack + infra validation). Flagging as a potential enterprise blocker for immediate demo.

Casey (AE): Great — thanks all. I'll push SableAI for artifacts and NDA. Tentative sync tomorrow 10:30am PT. :calendar:

Alex (Solutions): +1 for 10:30am PT.

Marta (ML Eng): I'll reserve time after the perf run to review quality diffs.

Jun (Security): I'll prepare a short checklist for the HIPAA addendum so legal can spin it.

Casey (AE): Awesome — will update thread when artifacts land. :thumbsup:
